description: Source manifest for the DIETOLOGY overlay layer. Every DRI overlay file references a source_id from this manifest. This file supersedes sources.json for DRI data — model loads this AFTER sources.json to get the authoritative overlay dataset catalog.

msd-manual-dri.name: MSD Manual Professional — DRI Tables
msd-manual-dri.tier_note: Upgraded from B: all values now machine-verified via extract-msd-dri-parser.py. Original Tier B reflected manual transcription — overlay replaces that with parsed values while preserving metadata.
msd-manual-dri.license: Copyright Merck & Co. — numeric facts not copyrightable
msd-manual-dri.authority_note: Reproduces National Academies DRI values in HTML format. Peer-reviewed professional medical reference published since 1899.
msd-manual-dri.description: Dietary Reference Intakes (RDA, AI, UL) for 11 vitamins and 9 trace minerals by age and sex. Values extracted via HTML parser, metadata (ul_note, unit_note, proper unit names) from manual transcription.

iom-dri-2011.name: IOM Dietary Reference Intakes — Calcium and Vitamin D (2011)
iom-dri-2011.license: Free PDF download — numeric facts not copyrightable
iom-dri-2011.mit_compatible_note: Numeric DRI values are facts established by the US/Canadian governments. Full citation: Institute of Medicine. 2011. Dietary Reference Intakes for Calcium and Vitamin D. Washington, DC: The National Academies Press.
iom-dri-2011.format: PDF with text layer (born-digital, 2011). Parser: extract-iom-dri.py (pdfplumber).
iom-dri-2011.authority_note: Current authoritative DRI for Calcium. Supersedes IOM 1997 values for this nutrient. Provides finest granularity: 22 age/sex groups including teen/adult pregnancy/breastfeeding subgroups with separate UL groups.
iom-dri-2011.description: Current DRI tables for calcium across all age/sex groups. Extracted from Table S-1 (Summary Tables, pp. 499–542). Calcium RDA/AI + UL groups per age.

iom-dri-1997.name: IOM Dietary Reference Intakes — Ca, P, Mg, Vitamin D, Fluoride (1997)
iom-dri-1997.license: Free PDF download — numeric facts not copyrightable
iom-dri-1997.mit_compatible_note: Numeric DRI values are facts established by the US/Canadian governments. Full citation: Institute of Medicine. 1997. Dietary Reference Intakes for Calcium, Phosphorus, Magnesium, Vitamin D, and Fluoride. Washington, DC: The National Academies Press.
iom-dri-1997.format: PDF with text layer (born-digital, 1997). Cross-verified via NCBI Bookshelf machine-readable HTML.
iom-dri-1997.authority_note: Original DRI report establishing RDA/AI for P and Mg. Values extracted from NCBI Bookshelf HTML rendering (clean machine-parseable table, same IOM 1997 source) and cross-verified against manual transcription: 24/28 groups 100% match, 4 PARTIAL_MATCH due to pregnancy/breastfeeding granularity difference (teen vs adult). UL values from LPI (lpi-mic-minerals) — IOM 1997 PDF scrambled, LPI HTML provides clean machine-readable reproduction.
iom-dri-1997.description: Current DRI for phosphorus and magnesium. RDA/AI values from NCBI Bookshelf (ttt00057_1 table) — machine-readable rendering of IOM 1997 RDA/AI summary. UL values from Linus Pauling Institute (machine-readable HTML, cites IOM 1997). Cross-verified against manual transcription from original PDF.

cross_verification_results.partial_match_note: 4 pregnancy/breastfeeding groups: manual used adult values for consolidated groups, NCBI shows per-subgroup values. Teen values (≤18y) are systematically higher. Overlay uses NCBI per-subgroup values for finest granularity.

msd-consumer-minerals.name: MSD Manual Consumer — Overview of Minerals
msd-consumer-minerals.tier_note: Tier B because adult values only. Now superseded by nas-dri-2019 for Na/K — retained for metadata (notes, per-group annotations) only.
msd-consumer-minerals.license: Copyright Merck & Co. — numeric facts not copyrightable
msd-consumer-minerals.authority_note: Consumer edition of MSD Manual. Adult RDA/AI values only. Values superseded by nas-dri-2019 (Na/K: 22 groups, machine-verified). Retained as metadata source only.
msd-consumer-minerals.description: Adult RDA/AI for Na and K — metadata source only. Values in overlay now come from NAS 2019 (22 groups, machine-verified).
msd-consumer-minerals.limitation: Metadata only. Na/K values now from NAS 2019 (22 groups). Retained for per-group notes and nutrient-level metadata.

nas-dri-2019.name: NASEM Dietary Reference Intakes — Sodium and Potassium (2019)
nas-dri-2019.license: Free PDF download — numeric facts not copyrightable
nas-dri-2019.mit_compatible_note: Numeric DRI values are facts established by the US/Canadian governments. Full citation: National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine. 2019. Dietary Reference Intakes for Sodium and Potassium. Washington, DC: The National Academies Press.
nas-dri-2019.format: PDF with text layer (born-digital, 2019). 4-page Highlights summary. Parser: extract-nas-dri-2019.py (pdfplumber).
nas-dri-2019.authority_note: Current authoritative DRI for Sodium and Potassium in US/Canada. Supersedes IOM 2005 values. Introduces CDRR (Chronic Disease Risk Reduction Intake) concept. UL=ND for both nutrients — authoritative determination, not data gap.
nas-dri-2019.description: Current DRI for sodium and potassium: AI by age/sex/life-stage (22 groups each), CDRR for sodium. Table 1: Potassium AI. Table 2: Sodium AI + CDRR. 22 groups including infant, children, male/female (6 age brackets), pregnant (3 age brackets), breastfeeding (3 age brackets).

lpi-mic-minerals.name: Linus Pauling Institute — Micronutrient Information Center (Minerals)
lpi-mic-minerals.tier_note: Tier B — authoritative academic secondary source. Reproduces IOM 1997 UL values in clean machine-readable HTML tables where IOM PDF is scrambled.
lpi-mic-minerals.license: Copyright Oregon State University — numeric facts not copyrightable
lpi-mic-minerals.mit_compatible_note: Numeric DRI UL values are facts, not creative expression. LPI reproduces IOM 1997 UL values. Attribution: 'Based on IOM DRI 1997, as reproduced by Linus Pauling Institute, Oregon State University.'
lpi-mic-minerals.authority_note: Academic peer-reviewed source that faithfully reproduces IOM DRI UL values. Not independent from IOM (cites IOM 1997), but provides clean machine-readable HTML tables. Magnesium UL applies to supplemental magnesium only, not food sources.
lpi-mic-minerals.description: Tolerable Upper Intake Levels (UL) for Phosphorus (9 age groups: infants, children 1-3/4-8/9-13yr, adolescents 14-18yr, adults 19-70yr, adults >70yr, pregnancy, breastfeeding) and Magnesium (6 age groups: infants, children 1-3/4-8/9-13yr, adolescents 14-18yr, adults 19+yr). UL for Magnesium applies to supplemental magnesium only.

msd-macronutrients-per-kg.name: MSD Manual — Macronutrients DRI per kg
msd-macronutrients-per-kg.tier_note: Upgraded from B: values now machine-verified via extract-msd-dri-parser.py. Per-kg values are the primary form from IOM 1997 — more accurate for individual use than absolute DRI.
msd-macronutrients-per-kg.license: Copyright Merck & Co. — numeric facts not copyrightable
msd-macronutrients-per-kg.mit_compatible_note: Numeric DRI values are facts. Source: Institute of Medicine. 1997. Dietary Reference Intakes for Calcium, Phosphorus, Magnesium, Vitamin D, and Fluoride. Washington, DC: The National Academies Press.
msd-macronutrients-per-kg.format: HTML table (structured, parseable). All values in mg/kg of body weight.
msd-macronutrients-per-kg.authority_note: Reproduces IOM 1997 per-kg values. These are the PRIMARY form — absolute DRI values are derived by multiplying by reference body weights. Per-kg values are MORE accurate for individual use: multiply by actual body weight, not population reference weight.
msd-macronutrients-per-kg.description: Calcium, Phosphorus, Magnesium DRI in mg/kg for 17 age/sex groups. All values in mg/kg — model MUST multiply by individual body weight. Infants: AI. Children and adults: RDA.
msd-macronutrients-per-kg.convention: All values in mg/kg of body weight. Multiply by individual body weight for absolute daily intake. More accurate for individual use than fixed absolute DRI values.

dri-minerals-overlay.json.description: 14 minerals (Ca, P, Mg, Na, K, Fe, Zn, Cu, I, Se, Mn, Cr, Mo, F), 254 groups at finest available granularity. 0 manual_transcription, 0 manual source file dependencies — all values and metadata machine-verified or programmatically generated.
input_files: data/dri-p-mg-ul-parsed.json (P/Mg UL, LPI based on IOM 1997)
dri-minerals-overlay.json.ul_machine_verified: All 14 nutrients: trace minerals (MSD Professional), Calcium (IOM 2011), Sodium/Potassium (NAS 2019), Phosphorus/Magnesium (LPI based on IOM 1997)
dri-minerals-overlay.json.pregnancy_breastfeeding_granularity: split into teen (14-18yr), adult 19-30yr, adult 31-50yr for all nutrients (Ca, P, Mg, Na, K, trace minerals)

dri-vitamins-overlay.json.description: 11 vitamins, 154 groups. Machine-parsed values + full metadata (unit_note, ul_note, proper unit names) from manual transcription
input_files: data/dri-vitamins.json (metadata: unit names like mcg DFE/mg NE/mcg RAE/IU, ul_note, unit_note)
dri-vitamins-overlay.json.pregnancy_breastfeeding_granularity: single group (19-50yr), no teen split. MSD vitamins table does not provide teen/adult breakdown for pregnancy/breastfeeding — source limitation, not extraction error.

dri-macronutrients-per-kg-overlay.json.description: 3 nutrients (Ca/P/Mg in mg/kg), 51 groups. Per-kg values — model must multiply by individual body weight
dri-macronutrients-per-kg-overlay.json.convention: All values in mg/kg of body weight. Multiply by individual body weight. Infants: AI. Children and adults: RDA.

full_rebuild_command: python3 data/extract-msd-dri-parser.py && python3 data/extract-iom-dri.py && python3 data/extract-nas-dri-2019.py && python3 data/extract-lpi-ul.py && python3 data/build-minerals-overlay.py && python3 data/build-vitamins-overlay.py && python3 data/build-macronutrients-per-kg-overlay.py && python3 data/build-data-index.py && python3 data/build-sources-overlay.py
